scope: MEAS: independent gates/report, source, published bar-map, complete-sheet and visual review; not aural review.

report.finding: Report agrees with final gates, two source piano staves / 621 notes, pickup-plus-40-bar order and two-page pack. It explicitly rejects the numerically successful but wrong 1.62 s repeated opening in favour of the real 0.24 s pickup.

barMap.finding: All 621 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Both pages were inspected in full; actual SVG/index sets are exactly pickup 0 and bars 1–40. Last return begins with the matching D3/A3/D4/F-sharp4 pickup within bar 32 at 76.560 s, before bar 33 at 78.079 s.

resolvedFindings.finding: RomA4 moved the last-telling section and transition from 72 to 76.5 s, identifying the bar-32 beat-3 pickup rather than using a broad form-template match as a boundary. Listen text now correctly states p at the return and mf only in its second half (bar 37); the actual sheet was checked. The final-telling cue is at 78 s and the transition span is 68–84 s.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified in the final corrected candidate. The first pickup is retained rather than skipping to a repeated chord, and the slowing final attacks near 94.839 s remain before the estimated 97.08 s decay end.

version.finding: Complete No. 2 for piano. Repetitions are already written out; pickup 0 and 1–40 are traversed once without doubling the written-out repeats. No gross cut/arrangement mismatch identified.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; source and listen first-edition scan are identified separately, not asserted to be Betts’s physical copy.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. Seconds-based listening passages remain approximate; notation durations warped through fermatas/decay are not physical key releases.
